evidence.active_equation: 一 one + 土 earth = 王 king
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 王 king is 一 one axe-bearing figure entrusted to command the 土 earth.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a woman (母) with a hairpin in her hair. In ancient China, women of marriageable age wore a hairpin. Based on the original meaning "young woman" The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 𠂉 hair tuft + 母 mother = 每 every
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 母 mother combs 每 every 𠂉 hair tuft, leaving none tangled.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a cooking pot. Based on the original meaning "cauldron; cooking pot", now written as 甑. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 丷 split horns + 口 mouth + ⺌ small (top) + 日 sun = 曾 formerly
evidence.active_mnemonic: Because one arc of the 日 sun has passed since 丷 split horns crowned a ⺌ small 口 mouth, that happened 曾 formerly.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a tall building. Similar to 京.
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 口 mouth + 冂 outer frame + 口 mouth = 高 tall
evidence.active_mnemonic: Under a 亠 lid, one 口 mouth calls across a 冂 outer frame to another 口 mouth far below, showing it is 高 tall.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a knife. Similar to 刀 (knife), with an added dot marking where the blade is.
evidence.active_equation: 刀 knife + 丿 slash = 刃 blade
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 丿 slash on a 刀 knife marks its cutting 刃 blade.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a signboard attached to a door. Based on the original meaning "signboard". The meaning later shifted to "tablet" and "flat".
evidence.active_equation: 户 door + 𠕁 eight (open) = 扁 flat
evidence.active_mnemonic: Spread 𠕁 eight (open) slats from a 户 door into one 扁 flat panel.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand (又) lifting a piece of bamboo (个).
evidence.active_equation: 十 ten + 又 hand = 支 offshoot
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand counts 十 ten buds sprouting from one 支 offshoot.

evidence.source_gloss: be wedged or inserted between, pressed from two sides
evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person (大) being pushed by people on both sides.
evidence.active_equation: 大 big + 人 person + 人 person = 夾 press from both sides
evidence.active_mnemonic: One 人 person and another 人 person 夾 press from both sides, trapping a 大 big person between them.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 開.  Pictograph of two hands (廾) opening the bolt (一) on a door (門). The traditional component 門 was removed for simplification.
evidence.active_equation: 一 one + 廾 two hands = 开 open
evidence.active_mnemonic: 廾 two hands lift 一 one door bar to 开 open the gate.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a tiger.
evidence.active_equation: 虍 tiger (top) + 儿 human legs = 虎 tiger
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 虍 tiger crouches on 儿 human legs, then the 虎 tiger springs forward.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person squatting down. Based on the original meaning "to squat", now written as 蹲.
evidence.active_equation: 允 consent + 夂 walk = 夋 dawdle
evidence.active_mnemonic: With 允 consent to stop at every sight, hikers 夋 dawdle through their 夂 walk.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a man. The top horizontal stroke either distinguishes it from the character 大 or depicts a hairpin, something that was only worn by adults.
evidence.active_equation: 一 one + 大 big = 夫 husband
evidence.active_mnemonic: Traditionally, 一 one hairpin crowned a 大 big adult figure who enters a wedding as the 夫 husband.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a chisel-like tool. The meaning later shifted to "hard" and "laborious".
evidence.active_equation: 立 standing up + 十 ten = 辛 peppery
evidence.active_mnemonic: A sign 立 standing up beside 十 ten sauces ranks them from mild to 辛 peppery.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with a line through their legs. Original meaning unclear.
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 几 small table = 亢 proud
evidence.active_mnemonic: Above a 几 small table, a 亠 lid lifts like the chin of someone standing 亢 proud.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with a line added at the head area, representing the meaning the meaning "head" or "first".
evidence.active_equation: 一 one + 兀 stand tall = 元 beginning
evidence.active_mnemonic: At the 元 beginning, 一 one figure must 兀 stand tall before all the others rise.

evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of a person (人) taking a stroll amid plants (屮). The 攵 component was added later.
evidence.active_equation: 士 soldier + 方 direction + 攵 tap = 敖 ramble
evidence.active_mnemonic: With no fixed 方 direction, a 士 soldier follows each 攵 tap of his boots and begins to 敖 ramble.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 兒.  Variant form of 人, a pictograph of a human.
evidence.active_equation: 丿 slash + 乚 turning hook = 儿 child
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 丿 slash and 乚 turning hook form the running legs of an 儿 child.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person carrying a burden or an axe on their shoulder. Same in origin to 何.
evidence.active_equation: ◎ marker + 人 person = 冘 move on
evidence.active_mnemonic: After passing the ◎ marker, the 人 person must 冘 move on along the path.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a snake, now written as 蛇. The current use as a pronoun is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 宀 roof + 匕 ancient spoon = 它 it
evidence.active_mnemonic: Under a 宀 roof, someone points at an 匕 ancient spoon and asks for 它 it to be passed over.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a dog (犬) with an object on it that is making the dog stumble. Original form of 跋. Also used as a variant of 拔 (to pull up).
evidence.active_equation: 犬 dog + ◎ marker = 犮 pull up
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 犬 dog catches the ◎ marker in its teeth and strains to 犮 pull up.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person standing under the rain (雨), representing the meaning "become wet", now written as 濡. The current meaning is a phonetic loan. The person component was later replaced with the phonetic component 而.
evidence.active_equation: 雨 rain + 而 and = 需 need
evidence.active_mnemonic: Caught in 雨 rain, you 需 need cover 而 and warmth.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of three stalks of grain. Alludes to the even and uniform appearance of a grain field.
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 刀 knife + 丫 forked = 齊 identical
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 刀 knife trims every 丫 forked stalk against one 亠 lid, making their silhouettes 齊 identical.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a tongue extending from an open mouth. Visually similar to 舌 (tongue).
evidence.active_equation: ⺧ cow (side) + 口 mouth = 告 declare
evidence.active_mnemonic: A ⺧ cow opens its 口 mouth to 告 declare its arrival.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a sprout (屮) emerging from the ground (一).
evidence.active_equation: 屮 sprout + 一 one = 生 life
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 屮 sprout pushing through 一 one ground line bursts into 生 life.

evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of a stove, based on the original meaning "stove", now written as 爐. The 虍 and 皿 components were added later. In modern Mandarin this character is usually only used for its sound in foreign loan words.
evidence.active_equation: 𧆨 food vessel + 皿 dish = 盧 hut
evidence.active_mnemonic: Inside a sparse 盧 hut, a 𧆨 food vessel and 皿 dish are the only furnishings.

evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of a temple or a shrine. The meaning later shifted to "food offering" and "enjoy".
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 口 mouth + 子 child = 享 receive
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 子 child opens a 口 mouth as you lift the 亠 lid, ready to 享 receive the meal.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a tall building. Similar to 高. Based on the original meaning "high place". The meaning of this character has shifted over time and now means "capital city".
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 口 mouth + 小 small = 京 capital
evidence.active_mnemonic: Beneath a 亠 lid, a giant 口 mouth announces decrees over 小 small buildings throughout the 京 capital.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a small shelter. Based on the original meaning "residence", now written as 舍. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 亼 assemble + 朩 tree = 余 excess
evidence.active_mnemonic: After workers 亼 assemble every usable branch from a 朩 tree, the leftover pile is 余 excess.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a ritual object made out of several pieces of jade joined together by a string. A dot was later added to 玉 to distinguish it from 王 (king).
evidence.active_equation: ◎ marker + 丶 dot = 玉 jade
evidence.active_mnemonic: On the ◎ marker of a strung ritual ornament, the distinguishing 丶 dot marks 玉 jade.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of something sweet inside the mouth (口).
evidence.active_equation: 口 mouth + ◎ marker = 甘 sweet
evidence.active_mnemonic: The ◎ marker inside a 口 mouth pinpoints where a taste turns 甘 sweet.

evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of a cricket, since cricket chirps indicate the beginning of autumn. Later the character was reanalyzed as 禾 (grain) + 火 (fire).
evidence.active_equation: 禾 standing grain + 火 fire = 秋 autumn
evidence.active_mnemonic: At harvest in 秋 autumn, 禾 standing grain glows like 火 fire.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a foot (止) exiting a cave (凵).
evidence.active_equation: 屮 sprout + 凵 receptacle = 出 exit
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 屮 sprout pushes out through the opening of a 凵 receptacle, revealing an 出 exit.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a ladle with food in it.
evidence.active_equation: 勹 wrap + 丶 dot = 勺 ladle
evidence.active_mnemonic: A curved 勹 wrap encloses a 丶 dot of food in the bowl of a 勺 ladle.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand (又) climbing a cliff (厂). Based on original meaning "climb", now written as 扳. The meaning later shifted to "pull" and "reverse".
evidence.active_equation: 𠂆 stretch + 又 hand = 反 against
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand holds one end 反 against the pull as cloth begins to 𠂆 stretch.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 見.  Pictograph of a person (儿) using their eye (目) to see (見).
evidence.active_equation: 目 eye + 儿 human legs = 见 see
evidence.active_mnemonic: Standing on 儿 human legs, a 目 eye turns slowly to 见 see the whole scene.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a child (人) with an opening in the top of its head (囟). Represents the soft spot (fontanel) at the top of young infant heads. The 囟 component is written like 臼.
evidence.active_equation: 臼 mortar + 儿 human legs = 兒 youngster
evidence.active_mnemonic: Small 儿 human legs brace against a 臼 mortar as an 兒 youngster peers inside.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand (又) reaching to grab a person (人).
evidence.active_equation: 人 person + 又 hand = 及 catch up with
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand reaches a departing 人 person just in time to 及 catch up with them.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand (又) grabbing an ear (耳). In ancient China, the ears of opponents in battle were cut off and collected as tokens of victory.
evidence.active_equation: 耳 ear + 又 hand = 取 take
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand grips a toy rabbit by one soft 耳 ear to 取 take it from the shelf.

evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of one person following another (从).  Later the 彳 and 止 components were added to indicate movement.
evidence.active_equation: 彳 step + 从 people following + 龰 foot = 從 follow
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 龰 foot matches every 彳 step of 从 people following the leader and begins to 從 follow.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person facing upwards with their mouth open over a fire. Based on the original meaning "burn". The meaning later shifted to "bake", "dry out", and "clay".
evidence.active_equation: 廿 twenty + 口 mouth + 龶 growth = 堇 yellow
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 口 mouth tastes 廿 twenty grains once their 龶 growth ripens 堇 yellow.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a rope neatly wrapped around a weapon handle. Based on the original meaning "orderly". The meaning later shifted to "next in sequence" (now written as 第) and "younger brother".
evidence.active_equation: 丿 slash + 丷 split horns + 弔 condole = 弟 younger brother
evidence.active_mnemonic: 丿 slash over 丷 split horns and 弔 condole gives 弟 younger brother his place.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a tree (木) with a mark indicating where the trunk is. Based on the original meaning "tree trunk", now written as 株. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 丿 slash + 未 not yet = 朱 vermilion
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 丿 slash through a seal impression that is 未 not yet dry smears its 朱 vermilion pigment.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 自 is a pictograph of a nose and 畀 represents the sound.
evidence.active_equation: 自 oneself + 畀 give = 鼻 nose
evidence.active_mnemonic: To indicate 自 oneself, 畀 give a quick tap to your 鼻 nose.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with a hat, now written as 冕. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: ⺈ knife (side) + 口 mouth + 丨 line + 儿 human legs = 免 avoid
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 口 mouth warns 儿 human legs to 免 avoid crossing the 丨 line toward a ⺈ knife.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a earthen jar for holding liquid, now written as 瓮. The current meaning "public" is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 八 eight + 厶 secret = 公 public
evidence.active_mnemonic: Share one 厶 secret along 八 eight paths, and it becomes 公 public.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person (大) with a cangue (torture device for punishing criminals) around his neck. People wearing such devices were not able to reach their mouth with their own hands, and were forced to beg for food.
evidence.active_equation: ◎ marker + 大 big = 央 center
evidence.active_mnemonic: An ◎ marker wraps around the waist of a 大 big figure, pinpointing the 央 center.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an eye (目) being poked with something sharp. In ancient China, slaves were sometimes punished by blinding them with a sharp object. Based on the original meaning "slave". The meaning later shifted to "common person".
evidence.active_equation: 目 eye + ◎ marker = 民 people
evidence.active_mnemonic: An ◎ marker beside each 目 eye lets a census count 民 people.

evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of a wren. Based on the original meaning "wren", now written as 鷦. Later used as a phonetic loan for "burn", after which the fire (灬) component was added.
evidence.active_equation: 隹 short-tailed bird + 灬 fire (bottom) = 焦 apprehensive
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 隹 short-tailed bird perched above 灬 fire grows 焦 apprehensive as the flames rise.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand holding a writing utensil.
evidence.active_equation: 又 hand + ◎ marker = 聿 writing
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand grips an ◎ marker and moves it across the page in 聿 writing.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person standing erect with something above the head, based on the original meaning "tall". The meaning later shifted to "outstanding" and "profound".
evidence.active_equation: ⺊ divination + 早 early = 卓 eminent
evidence.active_mnemonic: Accurate ⺊ divination makes a seer 卓 eminent 早 early in life.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a pig (豕) being pierced or shot by an arrow. Similar in origin to 彘.
evidence.active_equation: 彑 snout + 𧰨 pig alternate form = 彖 hog
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 彑 snout rooting ahead of a 𧰨 pig alternate form belongs to a 彖 hog.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a basket or a bag. The current meaning "east" is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 日 sun + 木 tree = 東 east
evidence.active_mnemonic: 東 east is where 日 sun first brightens the branches of a 木 tree.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an arrow (矢) hitting a target. Based on the original meaning "target (archery)". The meaning of this character has shifted over time and now means "marquis", likely because archery was associated with people of high ranking.
evidence.active_equation: 亻 person (side) + 𠃍 hook corner + 一 one + 矢 dart = 侯 marquis
evidence.active_mnemonic: Traditionally, the 侯 marquis is a high-ranking 亻 person aiming 一 one 矢 dart at a target's 𠃍 hook corner.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of clothing surrounding (囗) a person (大), now written as 裀. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 囗 enclosure + 大 big = 因 cause
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 大 big shape inside a 囗 enclosure becomes the 因 cause of the squeeze.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of two hands pulling a rope.
evidence.active_equation: 爫 reaching hand + 一 one + 友 friend = 爰 lead
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 爫 reaching hand takes 一 one 友 friend and begins to 爰 lead the way.

evidence.source_hint: Same in origin to 需. Pictograph of a person (大) standing under the rain (雨), representing the meaning "become wet", now written as 濡. The current meaning is a phonetic loan. The 雨 (rain) component was later replaced with the phonetic component 而.
evidence.active_equation: 而 and + 大 big = 耎 weak
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 大 big beam bends, 而 and keeps yielding because it has grown 耎 weak.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a left hand. The 工 (work) component was added later to represent the meaning "help; assist", now written as 佐.
evidence.active_equation: 𠂇 left hand + 工 work = 左 left
evidence.active_mnemonic: You use your 𠂇 left hand to hold the wood steady while you 工 work on the 左 left side of the bench.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of one person following another.
evidence.active_equation: 人 person + 人 person = 从 follow
evidence.active_mnemonic: One 人 person begins to 从 follow directly behind another 人 person.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of fire on top of a person.
evidence.active_equation: ⺌ small (top) + 一 one + 儿 human legs = 光 ray
evidence.active_mnemonic: A ⺌ small lamp casts 一 one 光 ray between 儿 human legs.

evidence.source_hint: Original form of 為. Pictograph of a hand (又) guiding an elephant (象) to do work (in ancient China elephants were tamed to do work). Based on the meaning "to work; to do".
evidence.active_equation: 又 hand + 象 elephant = 爲 handle
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand guides a 象 elephant to 爲 handle heavy work.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an old person with long hair bent over and leaning on a cane.
evidence.active_equation: 耂 old (top) + 匕 ancient spoon = 老 old man
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 耂 old patriarch uses a 匕 ancient spoon to feed himself as an 老 old man.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of the roots and leaves of a plant, i.e. the extremities of a plant.
evidence.active_equation: 山 mountain + 而 and = 耑 specialized
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 山 mountain course links geology 而 and climbing, keeping its training 耑 specialized.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand picking off blades of grass.
evidence.active_equation: 勹 wrap + 屮 sprout + 勹 wrap + 屮 sprout = 芻 cut
evidence.active_mnemonic: Use one 勹 wrap around a 屮 sprout and another 勹 wrap around a second 屮 sprout before you 芻 cut both.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person (亻) carrying a heavy basket (東) on their back.
evidence.active_equation: 亻 person (side) + 東 basket = 重 heavy
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 亻 person carries a 東 basket on their back, and the load feels 重 heavy.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a memorial tablet used for spiritual rituals, similar to 示.
evidence.active_equation: 丶 dot + 王 king = 主 main
evidence.active_mnemonic: A single 丶 dot marks the 王 king who is 主 main among all rulers.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a mouth on top of a person, representing an older brother giving orders.
evidence.active_equation: 口 mouth + 儿 human legs = 兄 elder brother
evidence.active_mnemonic: Traditionally, a 口 mouth above 儿 human legs belongs to the 兄 elder brother directing younger siblings.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a lid (去) on top of a container (皿). Based on the original meaning "lid", now written as 蓋. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 去 go + 皿 dish = 盍 question
evidence.active_mnemonic: As you 去 go, an untouched 皿 dish leaves the 盍 question of why you will not stay for the meal.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a deer (鹿) with two beautiful antlers.
evidence.active_equation: 丽 magnificent + 鹿 deer = 麗 lovely
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 鹿 deer crowned with 丽 magnificent antlers looks 麗 lovely.

evidence.source_hint: Origin unclear. Traditionally explained as a pictograph of a blade of grass.
evidence.active_equation: 丿 slash + 七 seven = 乇 depend
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 丿 slash cannot stand alone; it must 乇 depend on 七 seven beneath it.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a rabbit.
evidence.active_equation: 免 avoid + 丶 dot = 兔 rabbit
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 丶 dot marks the tail of the 兔 rabbit poised to 免 avoid danger.

evidence.source_gloss: be wedged or inserted between, pressed from two sides
evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 夾.  Pictograph of a person (大) being pushed by people on both sides.
evidence.active_equation: 大 big + 人 person + 人 person = 夹 be wedged or inserted between
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 大 big person can 夹 be wedged or inserted between one 人 person and another 人 person.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a sharp weapon with a sharp head and tail decorations on the end. Similar in origin to 朿. Original meaning unclear.
evidence.active_equation: 一 one + 八 eight + 巾 cloth + 㸚 scattered or dispersed = 爾 you (literary)
evidence.active_mnemonic: A poet lifts 一 one canopy of 巾 cloth, finds 八 eight figures 㸚 scattered or dispersed, and addresses 爾 you (literary).

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand (爫) picking fruit from a tree (木).
evidence.active_equation: 爫 reaching hand + 木 tree = 采 pluck
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 爫 reaching hand stretches into a 木 tree to 采 pluck its fruit.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a container for storing things. Original form of 貯. In simplified Chinese 宁 is also used to mean "peaceful", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 寧.
evidence.active_equation: 宀 roof + 丁 nail = 宁 calm
evidence.active_mnemonic: Inside a quiet 宀 roof, a firmly set 丁 nail leaves everything 宁 calm.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a nest (甾) in a tree (木).
evidence.active_equation: 巛 river + 果 fruit = 巢 nest
evidence.active_mnemonic: Birds weave a 巢 nest beside 果 fruit on a branch bending over the 巛 river.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person dancing, with ox tails or bird feathers hanging from his arms, to pray for rain. Original form of 舞 (dance). The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 𠂉 hair tuft + 卌 fortieth + 一 one + 灬 fire (bottom) = 無 nothing
evidence.active_mnemonic: 灬 fire consumes the 卌 fortieth 𠂉 hair tuft and 一 one last strand, leaving 無 nothing.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a ghost (鬼) wielding a stick (卜), which is a fearful sight to behold. 鬼 is also a sound component.
evidence.active_equation: 田 rice field + 一 one + 𠄌 diagonal hook + 乀 stretch + 丿 slash = 畏 be afraid
evidence.active_mnemonic: Across a dark 田 rice field, 一 one 𠄌 diagonal hook, a long 乀 stretch, and a sudden 丿 slash resemble claw marks that make workers 畏 be afraid.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a kneeling person smoothing out their unkempt hair with their hands. Based on the original meaning "conform, obey". The 口 (mouth) component was added later when the character became more abstract.
evidence.active_equation: 艹 grass (top) + 右 right = 若 as if
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 艹 grass bends to the 右 right 若 as if bowing to an unseen guest.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of two hands grabbing a woman's (女) waist. The current meaning "want" is a phonetic loan. The original meaning "waist" is now written as 腰.
evidence.active_equation: 覀 west (cover) + 女 woman = 要 want
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 女 woman searches beneath 覀 west (cover) for the one thing she has come to 要 want.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person (卩) outside a city wall (囗). Appears as a component in the right side of characters as ⻏.
evidence.active_equation: 囗 enclosure + 卩 person kneeling = 邑 area
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 囗 enclosure marks the 邑 area where a 卩 person kneeling waits beside the wall.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a container made out of bamboo. Variant of 𠙹.
evidence.active_equation: 巛 river + 田 rice field = 甾 container
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 甾 container carries water from a 巛 river to irrigate each 田 rice field.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a yoke or harness attached to a work animal, such as a horse or ox.
evidence.active_equation: 厂 cliff + 㔾 seal = 厄 adversity
evidence.active_mnemonic: Losing a 㔾 seal over a 厂 cliff throws its keeper into 厄 adversity.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with hands (丮) bound by shackles (㚔). Based on the original meaning "seize". The meaning later shifted to "wield power", "carry out", and "hold".
evidence.active_equation: 幸 good fortune + 丸 pill = 執 clench
evidence.active_mnemonic: Treating the 丸 pill as 幸 good fortune, you 執 clench it tightly in your fist.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a warp beam used for holding silk in, also known as a spool. The modern meaning "9th heavenly stem" is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 丿 slash + 士 soldier = 壬 9th heavenly stem

evidence.active_mnemonic: At 午 noon, each 𠂉 hair tuft in a row of 十 ten casts its shortest shadow.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 豈. Pictograph of a drum standing upright with a decoration at top, similar to 壴. Refers to celebratory music played after victory in battle.

evidence.active_mnemonic: A 䏍 small worm traces every curve of a 𫧇 seal mark, demonstrating 能 ability.

evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 允 consent = 充 sufficient
evidence.active_mnemonic: The owner gives 允 consent to close the 亠 lid only when the jar's contents are 充 sufficient.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 尋. Pictograph of two outstretched arms measuring length. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

evidence.active_mnemonic: A 乛 hook mark hangs over a 头 head like a price tag: the marked item is what you 买 buy.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a Xiezhi, a mythical animal similar to a unicorn.

evidence.active_mnemonic: Across one arc of the 日 sun, a second 日 sun, and a third 日 sun, the same gem stays 晶 sparkling.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of four hands working together to lift something.
evidence.active_equation: 臼 mortar + 廾 two hands = 舁 carry
evidence.active_mnemonic: 廾 two hands lift the heavy 臼 mortar together so they can 舁 carry it.

evidence.active_mnemonic: A 彑 snout with trailing strips of 巾 cloth looks like a 㣇 long-haired beast.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a harness on a horse. Variant of 厄.
evidence.active_equation: 户 door + 乙 second = 戹 in difficulty
evidence.active_mnemonic: An 乙 second bar wedges the 户 door shut, leaving everyone 戹 in difficulty.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a hand holding a writing utensil (聿) and drawing something. The 聿 component was deleted for simplification.

evidence.active_mnemonic: 一 one line caps a 凵 receptacle around a gridded 田 rice field, framing a 画 drawing.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an arrow (矢) hitting a target (厂). Variant of 侯.
evidence.active_equation: 厃 high and dangerous + 矢 dart = 矦 target
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 矢 dart strikes the 厃 high and dangerous 矦 target.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 競. Pictograph of two people side-by-side competing with each other.

evidence.active_equation: 小 small + 系 lineage = 縣 county
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 小 small branch of a 系 lineage administers one 縣 county within a larger realm.

evidence.source_hint: Variant of 聿. Pictograph of a hand holding a writing utensil.
evidence.active_equation: 又 hand + ◎ marker = 肀 brush
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand grips the ◎ marker as a 肀 brush and sweeps its tip across paper.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a kind of vessel used for holding wine with the small dots in it representing the wine contained in the vessel.
evidence.active_equation: 𠚍 cut stroke + 匕 ancient spoon = 鬯 sacrificial wine
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 匕 ancient spoon ladles 鬯 sacrificial wine from a vessel marked by a 𠚍 cut stroke.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an agricultural tool with a blade (戈) used by two people (从).
evidence.active_equation: 戈 halberd + 从 people following = 㦰 break off
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 戈 halberd planted between 从 people following makes them 㦰 break off their alliance.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person (元) wearing a hat (冃). 元 also represents the sound. The 寸 (hand) component was added later to possibly indicate the hat is being held and put onto the head.
evidence.active_equation: 冖 cover + 㝴 round off = 冠 crown
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 冖 cover fitted over a ruler's head can 㝴 round off the silhouette into a 冠 crown.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of three mouths (口) linked together.
evidence.active_equation: 品 goods + 山 mountain = 喦 talkative
evidence.active_mnemonic: A merchant hauling 品 goods over a 山 mountain grows 喦 talkative, describing every item along the climb.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a pot used for holding liquids.
evidence.active_equation: 士 soldier + 冖 cover + 一 one = 壺 kettle
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 士 soldier lifts the 冖 cover from 一 one steaming 壺 kettle.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph a person with a mark indicating the location of the thigh. Original form of 股.
evidence.active_equation: 乃 only then + 又 hand = 夃 thigh
evidence.active_mnemonic: Passing the waist, a 又 hand can 乃 only then reach the 夃 thigh.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 宮. Pictograph of a building (宀) with multiple rooms.
evidence.active_equation: 宀 roof + 吕 pitchpipe = 宫 palace
evidence.active_mnemonic: A royal 吕 pitchpipe sounds beneath the vast 宀 roof of the 宫 palace.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a building (宀) with multiple rooms.
evidence.active_equation: 宀 roof + 呂 spine = 宮 palace
evidence.active_mnemonic: Room after room beneath one 宀 roof follows a central 呂 spine through the 宮 palace.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 棄.  Pictograph of two hands (廾) putting a child (子) in a basket (其) for the purpose of abandoning or disposing with it. The traditional component 其 was removed for simplification.
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 弁 differentiate = 弃 reject
evidence.active_mnemonic: Lift each 亠 lid to 弁 differentiate what to keep and what to 弃 reject.

evidence.source_hint: The top component is a pictograph of a zither-like stringed musical instrument. 今 is a sound component.
evidence.active_equation: 玨 paired jades + 今 now = 琴 stringed instrument
evidence.active_mnemonic: 玨 paired jades hang from taut cords; pluck them 今 now and they ring like a 琴 stringed instrument.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a goat.
evidence.active_equation: 艹 grass (top) + 見 see + 丶 dot = 萈 huán
evidence.active_mnemonic: A small-horned goat parts 艹 grass as you 見 see its tiny horn like a 丶 dot, then call it 萈 huán.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of two hands (廾) opening the bolt (一) on a door (門).
evidence.active_equation: 閂 latch + 廾 two hands = 開 open
evidence.active_mnemonic: 廾 two hands slide back the 閂 latch, allowing the doors to 開 open.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an owl.
evidence.active_equation: ⻀ grass (top) + 隹 short-tailed bird = 雈 owl
evidence.active_mnemonic: At night, the 雈 owl is a wide-eyed 隹 short-tailed bird waiting silently in ⻀ grass.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with a bearded face. Simplified form of 須. The meaning "must" is a phonetic loan.
evidence.active_equation: 彡 hair + 页 head = 须 must
evidence.active_mnemonic: 彡 hair on a 页 head grows as it 须 must, without asking permission.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person (亻) standing upright on the ground (土).
evidence.active_equation: 亻 person (side) + 土 earth = 𡈼 stand upright
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 亻 person plants both feet firmly on 土 earth to 𡈼 stand upright.

evidence.source_hint: Variant of 開. Pictograph of two hands (廾) opening the bolt (一) on a door (门).
evidence.active_equation: 门 gate + ◎ marker + 廾 two hands = 𫔭 start
evidence.active_mnemonic: 廾 two hands remove the ◎ marker serving as a bolt on the 门 gate to 𫔭 start opening it.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a curved knife-like object.
evidence.active_equation: 亠 lid + 䒑 grass top + 丨 line = 䇂 sickle
evidence.active_mnemonic: A curved 䒑 grass top hangs beneath a 亠 lid, hooked beside a 丨 line like a 䇂 sickle.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of one stalk of bamboo. Same as one half of the character for bamboo (竹).
evidence.active_equation: 𠆢 person roof + 丨 line = 个 individual
evidence.active_mnemonic: 𠆢 person roof over 丨 line singles out 个 individual.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with both hands outstretched.
evidence.active_equation: ⺄ second stroke + 𰀁 inner line = 丮 catch
evidence.active_mnemonic: The ⺄ second stroke hooks around the 𰀁 inner line to 丮 catch it.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 傘.  Pictograph of an umbrella.
evidence.active_equation: 𠆢 person roof + 十 ten + 丷 split horns = 伞 parachute
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 伞 parachute spreads a 𠆢 person roof over 十 ten cords, its harness forking like 丷 split horns.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of an umbrella.
evidence.active_equation: 𠆢 person roof + 十 ten + 𠈌 walking person = 傘 umbrella
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 𠈌 walking person raises a 傘 umbrella, spreading a 𠆢 person roof across 十 ten ribs.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 鳳.  Phonosemantic compound. 鳥 represents the meaning and 凡 represents the sound. Originally a pictograph of a mythical Chinese bird, similar to a phoenix. Later the phonetic component 凡 was added.
evidence.active_equation: ⺇ table + 又 hand = 凤 phoenix
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 又 hand offers fruit on a ⺇ table to the descending, many-colored 凤 phoenix.

evidence.source_gloss: cutting off feet as form of punishment
evidence.source_hint: Originally a pictograph of a saw cutting off a person's foot. Later the character was changed to a phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 月 represents the sound.
evidence.active_equation: 月 flesh + 刂 knife (side) = 刖 cutting off feet
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 刂 knife (side) bites into 月 flesh in the punishment of 刖 cutting off feet.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 縣.  Pictograph of a severed head (首) hanging on a rope (系) from a tree (木). Based on the original meaning "hang" or "suspend". The current meaning is a phonetic loan. The traditional component 系 was removed for simplification.
evidence.active_equation: 且 moreover + 厶 secret = 县 district
evidence.active_mnemonic: An 厶 secret map marks which villages, 且 moreover which roads, belong to one 县 district.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 壺. Pictograph of a pot used for holding liquids.
evidence.active_equation: 士 soldier + 冖 cover + 业 business = 壶 vase
evidence.active_mnemonic: At a 业 business selling flowers, a 士 soldier lifts a 冖 cover from the 壶 vase.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of Kui, a figure in ancient Chinese mythology.
evidence.active_equation: 丷 split horns + 頁 head + 止 foot + 巳 the hours from 9 to 11 + 夂 walk = 夔 one-legged monster
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 夔 one-legged monster has 丷 split horns, a 頁 head, one 止 foot, appears at 巳 the hours from 9 to 11, and lurches in a 夂 walk.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of hands (廾, 手) carrying a person.
evidence.active_equation: 卩 person kneeling + 手 hand + 廾 two hands = 承 undertake
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 卩 person kneeling accepts a duty in one 手 hand, then supports it with 廾 two hands to 承 undertake it.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 禽 represents the sound. Originally written as 禽, which is a pictograph of a net with a handle used for hunting.
evidence.active_equation: 扌 hand (side) + 禽 fowl = 擒 capture
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 扌 hand drops a net around a fleeing 禽 fowl to 擒 capture it.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a container for holding wine.
evidence.active_equation: 吅 noise + 冖 cover + 斗 big dipper = 斝 small jade wine cup
evidence.active_mnemonic: Lift the 冖 cover: 吅 noise erupts as a 斗 big dipper shrinks into a 斝 small jade wine cup.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person standing up (𡈼) and gazing at the moon (月). 亡 is a sound component.
evidence.active_equation: 亡 deceased + 月 moon + 王 king = 望 expect
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 王 king looks at the 月 moon after a 亡 deceased messenger fails to return; he can only 望 expect news.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 午 represents the sound. Originally written as 午, a pictograph of a pestle used for pounding rice.
evidence.active_equation: 木 tree + 午 noon = 杵 pestle
evidence.active_mnemonic: At 午 noon, pound grain with a 木 tree trunk shaped into a 杵 pestle.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 棗.  Pictograph of a date tree.
evidence.active_equation: 朿 stab + 冫 ice = 枣 date tree
evidence.active_mnemonic: On a 枣 date tree, thorny branches 朿 stab through the crust of clinging 冫 ice.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 必 represents the sound. Originally written as 必, a pictograph of a weapon.
evidence.active_equation: 木 tree + 必 certainly = 柲 handle
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 木 tree 必 certainly provides a sturdy 柲 handle for a tool.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of two hands (廾) putting a child (子) in a basket (其) for the purpose of abandoning or disposing with it.
evidence.active_equation: 𠫓 newborn + 廿 twenty + 木 tree = 棄 forsake
evidence.active_mnemonic: Who could 棄 forsake a 𠫓 newborn beneath a 木 tree for 廿 twenty nights?

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a date tree.
evidence.active_equation: 朿 stab + 朿 stab = 棗 jujube
evidence.active_mnemonic: Picking a 棗 jujube brings a 朿 stab from one thorny branch and another 朿 stab from the next.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 者 represents the sound. Originally written as 耂, which is a pictograph of a tree with paper mulberry leaves.
evidence.active_equation: 木 tree + 者 person = 楮 mulberry
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 者 person strips bark from a 木 tree to make paper from the 楮 mulberry.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 歡. Phonosemantic compound. 欠 represents the meaning and 雚 represents the sound. 欠 (yawn) is a pictograph of a person with an open mouth, used here to represent a person joyfully laughing.
evidence.active_equation: 又 hand + 欠 deficient = 欢 joy
evidence.active_mnemonic: A song remains 欠 deficient until a 又 hand adds the missing beat, releasing 欢 joy through the crowd.

evidence.source_hint: Originally depicted a man carrying an axe while singing. Now a phonosemantic compound. 欠 (pictograph of a person opening their mouth) represents the meaning and 哥 represents the sound.
evidence.active_equation: 哥 older brother + 欠 deficient = 歌 song
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 哥 older brother, though 欠 deficient in breath, sustains every note of a 歌 song.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 欠 represents the meaning and 雚 represents the sound. 欠 (yawn) is a pictograph of a person with an open mouth, used here to represent a person joyfully laughing.
evidence.active_equation: 雚 stork + 欠 deficient = 歡 joyous
evidence.active_mnemonic: A colony left 欠 deficient grows 歡 joyous when its missing 雚 stork returns.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 火 represents the meaning and 主 represents the sound. Originally written as 主, a pictograph of a torch.
evidence.active_equation: 火 fire + 主 main = 炷 candle wick
evidence.active_mnemonic: The 主 main strand of a 炷 candle wick draws fuel up to the 火 fire.

evidence.source_hint: Variant form of 年. Pictograph of a person (人) harvesting grain (禾). The harvest season is a yearly event.
evidence.active_equation: 禾 standing grain + 千 thousand = 秊 year
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 千 thousand stalks of 禾 standing grain mature and are harvested once each 秊 year.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of two people side-by-side competing with each other.
evidence.active_equation: 竞 contend + 竞 contend = 競 compete
evidence.active_mnemonic: One rival begins to 竞 contend as another begins to 竞 contend, so the two 競 compete face-to-face.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. ⺮ represents the meaning and 其 represents the sound. Originally written as 其, a pictograph of a basket.
evidence.active_equation: 竹 bamboo + 其 their = 箕 winnowing basket
evidence.active_mnemonic: Each farmer tosses grain in 其 their 竹 bamboo 箕 winnowing basket.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 丩 represents the sound. Originally written as 丩, a pictograph of two ropes entangled together.
evidence.active_equation: 糸 thread + 丩 connect = 糾 entangle
evidence.active_mnemonic: When strands of 糸 thread 丩 connect through crossing loops, they 糾 entangle into a knot.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 糾.  Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 丩 represents the sound. Originally written as 丩, a pictograph of two ropes entangled together.
evidence.active_equation: 纟 thread + 丩 connect = 纠 investigate
evidence.active_mnemonic: To 纠 investigate, follow each 纟 thread and 丩 connect every clue until the tangle is explained.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a beard (而) being removed from the face by a hand (寸). Based on the original meaning "make the head bald as punishment", now written as 髡. The meaning later shifted to "tolerate" and "endure".
evidence.active_equation: 而 and + 寸 inch = 耐 withstand
evidence.active_mnemonic: A beam bends one 寸 inch, 而 and still can 耐 withstand the load.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a Qiang person kneeling down in respect. The 口 (mouth) component was added later since Qiang people were seen as slaves by the Shang people in ancient China. Original form of 敬.
evidence.active_equation: ⻀ grass (top) + 句 sentence = 茍 be circumspect
evidence.active_mnemonic: Before speaking in tall ⻀ grass, revise each 句 sentence and 茍 be circumspect about who may be listening.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 衤 represents the meaning and 因 represents the sound. Originally written as 因, a pictograph of clothing surrounding a person.
evidence.active_equation: 衤 clothing (side) + 因 cause = 裀 mat
evidence.active_mnemonic: Because cold ground is the 因 cause, you spread 衤 clothing beneath you for a 裀 mat.

evidence.source_hint: Component form of 言, which is a pictograph of a tongue (舌) sticking out of a mouth.
evidence.active_equation: ◎ marker + 舌 tongue = 訁 speech
evidence.active_mnemonic: The ◎ marker tracks a 舌 tongue moving from the mouth as 訁 speech flows out.

evidence.source_hint: Originally written as 兆, a pictograph of two people escaping a flood. The 辶 (walk) component was added later to clarify the meaning.
evidence.active_equation: 辶 movement + 兆 portent = 逃 escape
evidence.active_mnemonic: Quick 辶 movement away from an ominous 兆 portent allows the traveler to 逃 escape.

evidence.source_hint: Originally written as 屰, a pictograph of an upside-down person. The 辶 (walk) component was added later, representing a person walking in the wrong direction.
evidence.active_equation: 辶 movement + 屰 disobedient = 逆 go against
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 屰 disobedient marcher uses 辶 movement to 逆 go against the crowd's direction.

evidence.source_hint: Phonosemantic compound. 酉 represents the meaning and 殹 represents the sound. The 酉 component is a pictograph of a container for wine, which is sometimes used for medicinal purposes.
evidence.active_equation: 殹 echo + 酉 wine jar = 醫 physician
evidence.active_mnemonic: Traditionally, an 醫 physician stored medicinal wine in a 酉 wine jar that answered taps with a 殹 echo.

evidence.source_hint: Originally was a pictograph of a chicken. Later changed to a phonosemantic compound of 奚 and 隹 (bird).
evidence.active_equation: 奚 question + 隹 short-tailed bird = 雞 chicken
evidence.active_mnemonic: An 奚 question asks which 隹 short-tailed bird scratching in the yard is the 雞 chicken.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a person with an open mouth (欠) drinking from a wine vessel (酉). 欠 also represents the sound. The 酉 (wine) component and the open mouth was later reanalyzed as 飠 (eat).
evidence.active_equation: 飠 food + 欠 deficient = 飲 beverage
evidence.active_mnemonic: When 飠 food leaves a meal 欠 deficient, a 飲 beverage completes it.

evidence.source_hint: Simplified form of 飲. Pictograph of a person with an open mouth (欠) drinking from a wine vessel (酉). 欠 also represents the sound. The 酉 (wine) component and the open mouth was later reanalyzed as 饣 (eat).
evidence.active_equation: 饣 food (side) + 欠 deficient = 饮 drink
evidence.active_mnemonic: When 饣 food is 欠 deficient in moisture, pause to 饮 drink.

evidence.source_hint: Pictograph of a fully bloomed flower. 亏 represents the sound. Original form of 華/花.
evidence.active_equation: 𠂹 grass (alt) + 亏 deficit = 𠌶 flower
evidence.active_mnemonic: A 亏 deficit leaves the 𠂹 grass with just one bright 𠌶 flower.
